title: The Story of Sir Launcelot and His Companions
summary: "The Story of Sir Launcelot and His Companions" by Howard Pyle is a novel published in 1907. This Arthurian tale follows the legendary knight Sir Launcelot through a series of adventures alongside fellow Knights of the Round Table. From a shameful cart ride to rescue Queen Guinevere, to young Gareth's journey from kitchen boy to valiant knight, to encounters with mysterious ladies and fountains, these interconnected episodes explore themes of honor, love, and chivalry in King Arthur's court.
